title: Show separate handles to one shared thing
communicates: Separate ownership from resource identity. Keep the resource in place as access paths close.

source.title: fork(2), inherited file descriptors
source.locator: Technical constraint for an authored visual pattern

observation: A child inherits descriptors referring to the same open-file descriptions.
interpretation: Keep a shared socket identifiable while separate process handles connect to it and are released. The connected guide uses process frames, socket plugs, and access keys; the source supplies the technical constraint.
avoid: Do not draw a new connection merely because a handle was copied.
Do not label a handle closed while its owner still has access.
Changing an established symbol’s meaning to fit this pattern.
Choosing this pattern merely because a source paragraph can be animated.
Using identical circles for process, handle, and socket.
Using lists of ownership text as the main demonstration.

review.implementation: Current reference: connected-intuition SVG vocabulary. Original HTML/CSS renderer retained for historical compatibility.

implementation_status: The renderer field supports the earlier detailed experiment only. Its prose-card demo is retired from the recommended gallery.
